name: Schrödinger sandbox: reflecting edges
description: An empty focusing Schrödinger field (the ring track's medium) in a box with hard walls: a band of high potential (V = 30) round the border that nothing here has the energy to climb, so solitons bounce off the edges and everything stays in play (ripples too: nothing is lost, so the box slowly fills with them). Pause, paint tracks with the Params brush (V below 0 is a channel that guides solitons, V above 0 a barrier that turns them back), drop soliton stamps (⟲ ⟳ ⇋ in Stamps aim them; the thumbnail colour is the phase: red 0, yellow-green π/2, cyan π), then play. Display → mode → reagent + param outlines shows what you've painted.
